title.zh: OpenAI解雇3名安全研究员内幕：外部审计合作卷入泄密调查
title.en: OpenAI解雇3名安全研究员内幕：外部审计合作卷入泄密调查

current_state.zh: The Wall Street Journal reported that OpenAI fired three safety researchers in late September after an internal investigation into leaks of model-architecture secrets to external security expert Ryan Greenblatt, with the dismissed employees denying wrongdoing and alleging the move was retaliation for pushing AI-safety oversight.
